title: Water test (water_tests/items/<id>/water_test.json)
description: A water test product (a kit, a checker) and the tests it holds. Each test measures one parameter, either read directly as a value or by titration: the amount of reagent used is turned into a value with the table of the manufacturer. A kit with several tests (calcium, KH, magnesium...) lists them all; two ranges of the same parameter are two products.

name.description: Product name as printed by the manufacturer (not translated).

tests.description: The tests of the product, one per parameter.

parameter.description: Id of the parameter measured (an entry of the parameters catalog).

unit.description: Unit of the values, which is the unit of the parameter.

method.description: direct: the value is read (electronic checker, colour chart). titration: the amount of reagent used is converted with the table.

range.description: Values the test can read, for a direct test (a titration takes it from its table).

resolution.description: Smallest step the test can tell apart, in the unit of the values.

table.description: Titration only: points amount of reagent -> value; between two points the value is interpolated linearly.

verified.description: Conversion data checked against the manufacturer's manual. Unverified tests are not used by automatic dose proposals.

source.description: Where the data comes from (manual, label, URL). Required when verified.
